headline: Tier 1 IT support by day. I build software on my own time.
gameIntro: Hi, I'm Thomas Tahk, a developer for the web and video games

about.name: Thomas Tahk
about.text: I'm Thomas. I support ~80,000 students and staff at Albuquerque Public Schools through ServiceNow, and I build web apps end to end, AI-assisted. Before IT: localization PM in games, international logistics, and a microbiology degree from UC Berkeley. Bilingual English/Korean.

experience.description: Tier 1 IT support for ~80,000 users and 300,000 devices across 143 schools via ServiceNow ITSM. Manage incidents across Chromebooks, Windows/Mac laptops, iPads, and interactive displays using Active Directory, Microsoft Entra/Azure, Google Admin, and BeyondTrust.

Managed localized text across 3 live service products in 6+ languages. Helped re-localize 30,000+ lines of lost game text data to enable a successful relaunch, and bridged communication between the Korean development team and the global player community.
Coordinated international logistics and documentation for 100+ monthly import/export cases. Implemented workflow optimizations that improved case processing efficiency by 12%.
One-on-one academic support for K-12 students, adapting teaching approaches to different learning styles and developing personalized goal-setting frameworks with students and parents.

projects.name: priority-post
projects.oneLiner: A Discord assistant that plans my tasks, with an eval suite, and what broke along the way.
projects.description: A Discord assistant that plans my tasks, with an eval suite, and what broke along the way. The app itself is private; the repo holds the code and the eval suite.

projects.name: Dormant
projects.oneLiner: Client-side sleep tracker that exports FHIR R4 health data.
projects.description: Client-side sleep hygiene tracker built as a Health Data Innovators capstone. Exports FHIR R4 Bundles with LOINC-coded Observations for standards-compliant health data portability. Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, localStorage-only — no backend.

projects.name: kb-helper
projects.oneLiner: Offline tool for cleaning up ServiceNow knowledge-base articles. Built as a proposal for my team, not adopted.
projects.description: Offline tool for cleaning up ServiceNow knowledge-base articles. Built as a proposal for my team, not adopted.

projects.name: PlotPlan
projects.oneLiner: Hackathon crop-planning tool for small-scale farmers, backed by USDA data.
projects.description: Solo hackathon submission — a planning tool for small-scale farmers that combines user inputs with AI-generated recommendations anchored on USDA data. Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Anthropic SDK, Supabase.

projects.name: ServiceNow team workspace

projects.description: A team workspace built on my ServiceNow developer instance.

projects.name: Shows4Us
projects.oneLiner: Performing arts discovery and ticketing platform.
projects.description: Performing arts discovery platform for finding, researching, and ticketing musicals and live events. React 19/TypeScript/Vite 7 frontend, Node/Express backend with PostgreSQL via Supabase, Ticketmaster Discovery API integration.

projects.name: Amugonna
projects.oneLiner: Recipe recommendations from the ingredients you have.
projects.description: Full-stack recipe recommendation app that surfaces results based on a user's available pantry ingredients. React/TypeScript/Vite frontend, Node/Express/PostgreSQL backend deployed to Digital Ocean.
